correctness.rationale: On the repaired statement, n pair tests use n+1 i.i.d. base-k digits including the dangling final digit. Writing A=J-E_pq and B=J-E_rs, the even count is 1^T(AB)^m1. On (1,e_p), AB has trace k^2-2+de and determinant (kd-1)(ke-1). Counts k and k^3-2k+d follow from zero tests and inclusion-exclusion of the two events; joint occurrence is one word when q=r and none otherwise. The order-two recurrence gives all four rational numerators and denominators. The adjacent differences are k^2 z^2/(D_0 D_M), z/D_M and (k-1)^2 z^2/(D_M D_H). The reciprocals have strictly positive coefficients (positive roots for D_0,D_H; positive recursion for D_M), giving the onset and strict comparisons. The larger mid root satisfies P_H(lambda_M)=k(k-1)-lambda_M<0 and exceeds the largest D_0 root. Leading poles do not cancel (in the high case the positive leading root exceeds (k-1)/k); all are simple except the double binary D_0 root. Each next digit has at least k-1 allowable choices, giving the same rate on odd horizons by a multiplicative bound, not the same prefactor. At odd horizons, word reversal preserves the observation parity of each tested pair and swaps the overlap bits when the two forbidden pairs are themselves reversed. The mixed word counterexample and prefactor ratio were independently checked: python3 /workspace/branches/independent_checks.py 1. The original checker was inspected and not executed. Configuration frequencies follow from the two independent digit equalities, and the argument includes identical holes and k=2.
